curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach courtesy, pedestrian right-of-way, how long to wait, people who may not see you, and service animals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Pedestrian cards; contrast card for the two waiting rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on yielding to pedestrians.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach school bus lights, the stop rules for every lane, when to move again, two-lane and multilane roads, and transit buses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Bus cards; contrast cards for turn lanes, two-lane roads and the multilane exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when to stop for a school bus.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach truck blind zones and stopping distance, safe merging ahead, wide turns, hazardous loads, grades and snowplows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Large vehicle cards; contrast card for the two-headlight merge rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on driving near trucks and buses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach riders' rights and vulnerability, lane width, blind zones, road hazards and misleading lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Motorcycle cards; contrast card for brake and turn lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sharing the road with motorcycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach bicyclists' rights, lane use and following space, crosswalks, passing and bike lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Bicycle cards; contrast cards for road versus crosswalk and the passing gap.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on passing and yielding to bicyclists.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach crossings, train right-of-way, the stop zone, stalls, reporting problems and light rail spacing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Crossing cards; contrast cards for the stop zone and reporting numbers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach slow farm vehicles and passing them, and how to yield to emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Farm and emergency cards with a contrast card on rejoining traffic.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on slow and emergency vehicles.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
